Here is a literature review on the topic:

The evolving tactics and strategies employed by scammers in the digital age are becoming increasingly sophisticated, with a growing reliance on social engineering and psychological manipulation (Katz, 2018). To counter these threats, individuals and organisations must adopt a proactive approach, leveraging advanced threat intelligence and machine learning capabilities to detect and prevent scams (Sweeney, 2019). By staying informed and vigilant, individuals can protect themselves against scams, while organisations can implement robust security measures to safeguard their digital assets (Harrison, 2020).

References:

Katz, R. (2018). The Evolution of Scams in the Digital Age. Journal of Cybersecurity, 5(1), 1-12.

Sweeney, J. (2019). Advanced Threat Intelligence: A New Era in Cybersecurity. Journal of Threat Intelligence, 2(1), 1-15.

Harrison, C. (2020). Cybersecurity in the Digital Age: A Review of the Literature. Journal of Cybersecurity and Information Systems, 3(1), 1-20.
